name: google-chrome-windows-with-image
title: Google Chrome (Windows, w/ image)
description: Windows Google Chrome mock with bundled screen image under the omnibox; swap /images/blocks/... or pass children on the base component.

files.content: Place your asset here. Same base name, any supported format: jpg, jpeg, png, webp, avif, gif, or svg. Remove the .gitkeep extension from the filename.
